name: generic roleplay gaem.
desc:
🚌 Drive the bus, drive a taxi, race karts across town and send it off the jumps! 🏎️
🪓 Chop trees, fish, farm rice and fix up the town to earn cash. Every job keeps the server's economy alive 💰
🎭 12 roles: Driver, Guard, Doctor, Jester, Landlord, Council Member, Barbarian & more!
🚓 Turn criminal and run from the Guards… or be the Guard doing the chasing.
👑 Vote on REAL laws that change the game, or outlast everyone and become King ⚖️
🆕 Barbarians raid the gate, and if the town chops too many trees, the Tree Lord wakes up 😱
👫 Play with a friend to earn bonus quest cash!

🚨 Exploiting = permaban, no exceptions. False reports can also get you banned.
👥 Join the group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/5574524
